titleBar.closeWait: Please wait until the installation is complete

welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: Use this computer on all your screens.
welcome.lead: From a phone, a tablet, a TV or another computer, you see this screen as if you were sitting in front of it. The picture arrives within a few milliseconds, and the keyboard, mouse and controller respond straight away.
welcome.note: Setup takes about three minutes. Nothing changes on this computer until you click Install.
welcome.problemOne: One issue will stop sessions from working properly: see the details above.
welcome.problemMany: {count} issues will stop sessions from working properly: see the details above.

reinstall.label: Reinstallation
reinstall.title: KyberNow Station {version} is already installed.
reinstall.lead: Your devices already know this computer. Choose what happens to its settings.
reinstall.keepDetail: Accounts, added devices, certificate, Admin settings and ports ({ports}) stay as they are. Only the programs and drivers are replaced.
reinstall.keepImpossible: Not possible here: this installation's settings cannot be found.
reinstall.freshDetail: New account, new ports, new certificate, default settings.
reinstall.freshWarning: All your devices will lose access: you will need to add them again with the new account. Admin and Kyber settings go back to those of a first installation.

account.label: Your account
account.title: An account protects this computer.
account.lead: Without it, no one else on your network can connect to it.
account.hint: {strength}. The computer keeps only a hash of it, never the password itself.
account.passwordShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
account.consoleDetail: There you set up the virtual display, sound and accounts, and can create more accounts.

options.label: Options
options.title: The best settings are already chosen.
options.lead: You can change any of them later in KyberNow Admin.
options.virtualDisplay: Virtual display sized for each device
options.virtualDisplayDetail: The picture arrives at the device's resolution and refresh rate. The free driver that creates this display (SudoVDA) is not signed by Microsoft: its certificate will be added to the certificates Windows trusts.
options.gamepadsDetail: The computer sees your Xbox or PlayStation controller as a real controller (ViGEmBus driver). You may be asked to restart.
options.audioDetail: Sound plays on your device, up to 7.1, and the computer stays quiet. Steam's virtual speakers, found on this computer, take care of it.
options.audioMissing: This needs Steam, which provides signed virtual speakers. Without Steam, sound also plays on the computer.
options.startWithWindowsDetail: The Station is available as soon as the computer starts, even before you sign in to Windows. Its icon appears near the clock.
options.maxPerformanceDetail: The processor and graphics card keep their full speed during a session, so the delay stays steady.
options.maxPerformanceAlready: Already set: this computer is in High performance mode.

files.title: Kyber engine
files.text: It sends the picture and sound to your devices. Its files go into C:\Program Files\KyberNow.

cert.title: This computer's certificate
cert.text: It encrypts everything that passes between your devices and this computer.

service.title: Start with the computer
service.text: The Station becomes a Windows service: it starts on its own, even before you sign in.

firewall.title: Access from your devices
firewall.text: Windows Firewall opens ports {stream} (stream) and {console} (Admin), on your private network only.

vdd.title: Virtual display
vdd.text: It will take the size of each device that connects.

gamepad.title: Controllers
gamepad.text: The computer will recognise the controllers on your devices.

audio.title: Sound on your devices
audio.text: Steam's virtual speakers send the sound to the connected device.

admin.title: KyberNow Admin
admin.text: The Station's settings open in your browser, on port {port}.

power.title: Power mode
power.text: High performance mode avoids slowdowns during a session.
power.warn: refused by Windows: mode unchanged, everything else is installed

install.titleRunning: This computer will be ready soon.
install.leadDone: The Kyber engine, Admin and the drivers are installed.
install.leadRunning: There is nothing for you to do. Each step appears below as it happens.
install.remainingLong: Less than a minute to go

done.label: Installation complete
done.title: This computer is ready.
done.lead: Open KyberNow Link on one of your devices: on the same network, this computer shows up on its own. Otherwise, add it with its address:
done.reboot: Controllers will work after the next restart. Everything else already works.
done.phoneNote: Scan this code. The browser may warn about the certificate: the Station signs its own connection, this is expected.

roles.kybernow: KyberNow Station (installer, tray icon) and KyberNow Admin
roles.kyber: Picture, sound and input engine (Kyber SAS)

about.note: KyberNow is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence. The licence texts are installed in C:\Program Files\KyberNow\licenses.

simulation.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX (simulation) · compresses the picture (NVENC)
simulation.ports: The usual port 8080 is already in use by httpd.exe. Free ports, picked at random: stream {stream} · Admin {console}
simulation.powerDetail: The graphics card slows down to save energy, and compressing each picture can take up to three times longer. The Options step offers to change this mode.
simulation.audioDetail: Steam's virtual speakers found: during a session, sound plays on your device (stereo, 5.1 or 7.1) and the computer stays quiet.
simulation.existingDetail: At the next step, you will choose to keep your settings and devices, or to start from scratch.
simulation.samePort: The stream and Admin need two different ports.
simulation.portInUse: Port 8080 is already in use by httpd.exe.

checks.displaysDetail: {count} displays: off during a session, back at the end
checks.audioNew: A KyberNow sound output will be added to the Mac

welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: Your Mac, on all your screens.
welcome.lead: From a phone, a tablet, a TV or another computer, you get this screen as if you were sitting in front of it. The picture arrives in a few milliseconds, and the keyboard and mouse respond right away.
welcome.note: Installation takes about two minutes. Nothing changes on this Mac until you click Install.
welcome.problemOne: One issue prevents installation: see the line in red.
welcome.problemMany: {count} issues prevent installation: see the lines in red.

account.label: Your account
account.title: An account protects this Mac.
account.lead: Without it, nobody else on your network can connect to it.
account.hint: {strength}. This Mac only keeps a fingerprint of it, never the password itself.
account.hintEmpty: At least 10 characters. This Mac only keeps a fingerprint of it, never the password itself.
account.consoleDetail: There you set up the virtual display, sound and accounts, and can create more.

reinstall.title: KyberNow Station {version} is already on this Mac.
reinstall.lead: Keep your settings so your devices reconnect without doing anything again.
reinstall.keepDetail: Accounts, paired devices, certificate and ports stay:
reinstall.keepImpossible: The settings of the current installation can't be found.
reinstall.freshDetail: New account, new ports and new certificate: each device will need to be paired again.

options.label: Options
options.title: Everything is already set up for the best.
options.lead: You can change everything later in KyberNow Admin.
options.virtualDisplay: Virtual display sized for each device
options.virtualDisplayDetail: The picture arrives at the device's resolution and refresh rate, in HDR if it asks for it. The Mac's displays turn off during a session and come back at the end.
options.virtualAudioDetail: Sound comes out of your device, up to 7.1, and the Mac stays silent. A “KyberNow” sound output is added to the Mac.
options.startWithMacDetail: The Station is available as soon as you log in. Its icon appears in the menu bar.
options.keepReachableDetail: No sleep during a session, and wake over the network when a device asks.
options.gamepadsDetail: Waiting for Apple's approval: they will arrive with an update.
options.password: macOS will ask for your Mac's password once.

install.label: Installation · {percent}%
install.title: This Mac will be ready soon.
install.lead: You don't have anything to do. Each step shows up below as it goes.

tasks.kyberDetail: It sends the picture and sound to your devices. The app goes into Applications.
tasks.certDetail: It encrypts everything between your devices and this Mac.
tasks.audioDetail: The session's sound goes to your device, the Mac stays silent.
tasks.startupDetail: The Station starts on its own when you log in.
tasks.adminDetail: The Station's settings open in your browser.
tasks.firewallDetail: The macOS firewall lets the Station through, on your network.

permissions.label: Permissions · {count} of 3
permissions.title: Three permissions, just once.
permissions.lead: macOS asks for your permission so the Station can show this screen, follow your devices and read the session's sound. Turn on “KyberNow Station” in each setting: the line checks itself.
permissions.screenDetail: To send this screen's picture to your devices.
permissions.accessibilityDetail: So your devices' keyboard and mouse can control this Mac.
permissions.microphoneDetail: To read the session's sound on the KyberNow output. No real microphone is listened to.
permissions.later: Without these permissions the Station only half works: no picture, no controls or no sound. You can grant them later from the icon.

done.label: Installation complete
done.title: This Mac is ready.
done.lead: Open KyberNow Link on one of your devices: on the same network, this Mac shows up by itself. Otherwise, add it with its address:
done.menubar: The KyberNow Station icon is in the menu bar, at the top right.
done.missing: Some permissions are missing: grant them from the menu bar icon, Permissions menu.

update.label: Update · {from} → {to}
update.title: KyberNow Station {version} is ready.
update.lead: About a minute. The Station stops and starts again by itself: your settings, accounts and devices stay as they are.
update.upToDate: KyberNow Station {version} is up to date.
update.upToDateLead: Admin looks for new versions every six hours, and the icon lets you know.
update.session: A session is running on {name}: it will be cut off.
update.fine: Also from KyberNow Admin, System page. macOS doesn't ask again for your password or permissions.
update.doneLead: The Station is back with your settings.

uninstall.label: Uninstall
uninstall.title: Remove KyberNow Station from this Mac?
uninstall.lead: Your devices won't be able to connect to it anymore. The KyberNow Link apps on your devices are not affected.

items.app: The KyberNow Station app, the Kyber engine and KyberNow Admin
items.startup: Starting with the Mac and the menu bar icon
items.audioAside: sound goes back to your speakers

uninstall.keepDetail: Accounts, paired devices, loans and certificate stay on this Mac. If you reinstall, everything comes back as before, without pairing your devices again.
uninstall.password: macOS will ask for your Mac's password to remove the sound output.
uninstall.fine: Dragging the app to the Trash isn't enough: the sound output and startup items would stay. Use the icon or “Uninstall” in the .dmg.
uninstall.doneTitle: KyberNow Station is removed from this Mac.
uninstall.doneKept: Your settings and devices are kept: a reinstall will find them.
uninstall.doneAll: Nothing of the Station is left on this Mac.

simulation.chip: Apple M4 Max · hardware HEVC and H.264 encoding
simulation.macos: macOS 26.1 · virtual displays and HDR supported
simulation.samePort: The two ports must be different.
simulation.note1: The Mac's displays turn off faster when a session starts
